name: ruby-dev
description: Task-driven Ruby development toolkit: project scaffolding, data pipelines, multi-database (Ohm/Sequel/pgvector) modeling, GenAI components, RubyLLM client integration, typed LLM programs with dspy.rb, classical NLP toolkit, TUIs, desktop GUIs (glimmer-dsl-libui), diagnostics, refactoring, performance optimization, YARD documentation, and SIFT quality audits — routed by the `rubyist` multi-agent gateway, which plans a dispatch route and delegates every stage to one of 14 specialist subagents in isolated context.
